title: (RHBA-2020:0206) Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage 4.2.1 Container images update
portal_summary: Updated container images for Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage 4.2.1 are now available in the Red Hat Container Registry.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage 4.2.1 Container images update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|4|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258

The Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage 4.2.1 container images provided by this update can be downloaded from the Red Hat Container Registry at registry.redhat.io. Installation instructions for your platform are
available at Red Hat Container Catalog [1]
portal_description:
Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage is a software-defined storage integrated with and optimized for the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform. Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage is a highly scalable, production-grade persistent storage for stateful applications running in the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform. In addition to persistent storage, Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage provisions a multicloud data management service with an S3 compatible API.

With this update, you can use OpenShift Container Storage 4.2.1 on both OpenShift Container Platform 4.2.x and 4.3.x. 

Please note that upgrade to OpenShift Container Storage 4.2.1 is mandatory before upgrading to OpenShift Container Platform 4.3. 

Upgrading to OpenShift Container Platform without upgrading OpenShift Container Storage first, may result in Persistent Volumes going offline as well as blocking the OpenShift platform from an upgrade. If you inadvertently encounter such issues, contact Red Hat Support. The full OpenShift Container Storage and OpenShift Container Platform interoperability matrix are available at https://access.redhat.com/articles/4731161

All users of Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage 4.2 are advised to pull these updated images from the Red Hat Container Registry.
